overview: Rose Dating is a romantic social dating app on the Internet Computer featuring profiles, posts, stories, direct and group chats, a tokenized in-app Rose Credits economy, and real-time notifications. Users can connect, share media, gift roses, and trade ICP seamlessly in an elegant rose-themed interface.
features: User profiles with avatars and bios
Posts and story highlights with media support
Direct and group chats with real-time updates
Rose Credits in-app economy with ICP trading
Email notification settings with per-event toggles
Analytics dashboard for platform and personal stats
QR code system for direct chat sharing
